Comprehensive Guide to Midnight Dungeons

Last Updated: Aug 10, 2026 - 2:53 PM (1mo ago)
Daylea

Support Our Writers

Welcome to our overview of dungeons in the Midnight expansion. Here, you will find the latest information about dungeons available throughout the expansion, the current Mythic+ dungeon rotation, and the item level of rewards for the latest season.

Table of Contents
1. Introduction2. Dungeons in Midnight3. Windrunner Spire Dungeon4. Murder Row Dungeon5. Den of Nalorakk Dungeon6. Maisara Caverns Dungeon7. The Blinding Vale Dungeon8. Magisters' Terrace Dungeon9. Nexus-Point Xenas Dungeon10. Voidscar Arena Dungeon11. Altar of Fangs Dungeon12. Dungeon Rotation for Midnight Season 213. Item Level of Gear from Dungeons in Midnight Season 214. This Week's Dungeon Success Rates
1.

Introduction

The Midnight expansion contains 9 new dungeons. All dungeons on normal unlock either at a specific level or by completing a quest that leads you into the dungeon. Heroic and higher difficulties only require level 90.

For more details about Midnight Season 2, which sees three returning dungeons from previous expansions, check out our updated Mythic+ hub!

Midnight Mythic+ Season 2 Guide
2.

Dungeons in Midnight

Below are the dungeons for midnight and what level they unlock on normal difficulty. Alternatively, if you complete the quest chain in the zone that leads you into the dungeon you will unlock the ability to queue for it.

  • Windrunner Spire: Level 81
  • Murder Row: Level 83
  • Den of Nalorakk: Level 88
  • Maisara Caverns: Level 88
  • The Blinding Vale: Level 88
  • Magister's Terrace: Level 90
  • Nexus-Point Xenas: Level 90
  • Voidscar Arena: Level 90
  • Altar of Fangs: Level 90
3.

Windrunner Spire Dungeon

Windrunner Spire is located at 35.50, 78.80 Eversong Woods.

Once the hallowed home of the Windrunner family, Windrunner Spire now mirrors the scarred relationship between Alleria, Sylvanas, and Vereesa. Animosity during a reunion at the home drove suffering and grief into a haunted manifestation that binds the spirits there, unable to find peace.

3.1.

Bosses

  • Emberdawn: Emberdawn settled in the gardens of Windrunner Spire after seeking a place to raise her young. Highly territorial, she guards her nest with a searing ferocity.
  • Derelict Duo: The banshee Kalis and her loyal abomination Latch lead a group of fanatical followers of Sylvanas Windrunner. They've come to the Spire in search of relics with any resonant essence of the Dark Lady, willing to do anything to obtain them.
  • Commander Kroluk: Commander Kroluk once fought in the Second War, a conflict that ended the life of Alleria Windrunner's brother, Lirath. In her grief, Alleria slaughtered any Old Horde she could find. The vengeful spirits of those she defeated now haunt the Spire.
  • The Restless Heart: Born from the grief and wrath of the Windrunner family, the vengeful spirit of a once-proud Ranger-General haunts the halls of its abandoned ancestral home. Only by facing a worthy foe can it be laid to rest and finally know peace.
Windrunner Spire Dungeon Guide
4.

Murder Row Dungeon

Murder Row is located at 57.00, 61.00 in Silvermoon City, the major capital for Midnight located within Eversong Woods.

The darkened streets of Murder Row hide a secret fel-smuggling operation that has been preying on the fears of Silvermoon's citizens ever since the Voidstorm appeared.

4.1.

Bosses

  • Kystia Manaheart: Although an accomplished Magister, Kystia Manaheart was far too devoted to fel magic to give it up entirely. Little wonder she's become a staunch supporter and ally to underground fel smuggling operations in the Row.
  • Zaen Bladesorrow: Clever, quick-witted and commanding, Zaen Bladesorrow oversees the shipments of illegal fel artifacts. Those under his command follow his orders to the letter... or pay the price.
  • Xathuux the Annihilator: Xathuux the Annihilator is one of Lithiel Cinderfury's most powerful summons. Although he loathes serving the warlock, he follows her commands for the sheer visceral joy of destruction.
  • Lithiel Cinderfury: Lithiel Cinderfury sees the Voidstorm above Silvermoon as both threat and opportunity. Her people are afraid, and she has a perfect solution... the power of fel. She claims her smuggling operation protects her people from the dangers above, but the profits she receives are a pleasing bonus.
5.

Den of Nalorakk Dungeon

Den of Nalorakk is located at 31.00, 84.00 in Zul'Aman.

Wounded by Zul'jin and Malacrass, Nalorakk turned his back on the Amani, slumbering in his den to ease his pain. Now, the Amani seek to heal the rift between their tribe and the loa. But, to gain Nalorakk's favor, those who come before him must complete his trials. Assist Zul'jarra as she journeys into the mind of the Loa of War to defeat him and gain his blessing.

5.1.

Bosses

  • The Hoardmonger: Driven by voracious greed, the gluttonous Hoardmonger fiercely defends the stashes of food and supplies he has stolen from nearby troll tribes. Nalorakk's first trial is to eliminate him before the tribes go hungry.
  • Sentinel of Winter: The seasons can be kind or cruel. Sentinel of Winter unleashes the harshest of winter storms to test all who face him. To surpass Nalorakk's second trial, endure the biting cold and defeat the embodiment of a winter storm.
  • Nalorakk: Slumbering in his fitful and battle-filled dream, Nalorakk, the Loa of War, will only test the mettle of the worthy. Survive his trial and receive his blessing or die trying.
6.

Maisara Caverns Dungeon

Maisara Caverns is located at 43.90, 39.70 in Zul'Aman.

Beneath the sacred Maisara Hills, Vilebranch trolls sacrifice Witherbark captives to power their necromancy. Their rituals twist stolen souls into fuel for Rak'tul, a monstrous dire troll bound in the depths. If the cavern's magic is left to fester, Zul'Aman will face a terror it cannot contain.

6.1.

Bosses

  • Muro'jin and Nekraxx: Muro'jin is a relentless tracker, charged with capturing victims for the Vilebranch's dark rites. Nekraxx, a reanimated eagle, strikes down any who resist capture by her master. They must not be allowed to supply souls for Vordaza's necrotic magic any longer.
  • Vordaza: Vordaza, the Vilebranch's master of souls, performs forbidden rites to extract the soul essences of the dead. She distills the suffering of her victims into raw necrotic energy to empower Rak'tul, her monstrous creation. Her vile magic and her monster must be stopped.
  • Rak'tul, Vessel of Souls: An undead thrall bound to Vordaza, Rak'tul is grotesquely bloated with the essences of tormented souls and necrotic power. Drunk on his newfound power and driven mad by the souls' endless suffering, Rak'tul stands ready to break Zul'Aman beneath the crushing weight of his fists.
Maisara Caverns Dungeon Guide
7.

The Blinding Vale Dungeon

The Blinding Vale is located at 26.80, 78.00 in Harandar.

The Blinding Vale sprouted instantly. From within the Lightbloom, rutaani emerged and spread the Lightbloom in their wake. After the Lightbloom's defeat in Eversong, Orweyna began surgical strikes to keep the Lightbloom in check. But the hideous glare of the Blinding Vale hides a garden where the Lightbloom cultivates new creatures and magic to drive forward their one fanatical imperative growth unstoppable.

7.1.

Bosses

  • Lightblossom Trinity: The Lightbloom has suffered a terrible defeat, but like the rutaani it imbues, it changes. These Lightblossomed Rutaani fanatically propagate their vicious and invasive garden.
  • Ikuzz the Light Hunter: Ikuzz is a fearsome carnivore who once stalked prey throughout Harandar. Now the Light Hunter has succumbed to the overwhelming power of the Lightbloom, and his insatiable hunger serves its growth.
  • Lightwarden Ruia: The once-respected Rootwarden Ruia could not defeat the Lightbloom on his own. His wounded pride led him to drawing power from the Lightbloom and using it to punish all others instead of aiding his allies.
  • Ziekket: Born from the Lightbloom's epicenter, Ziekket was spawned and incubated by Light-infested rutaani to create an unstoppable engine of the Lightbloom's expansion.
8.

Magisters' Terrace Dungeon

Magisters' Terrace is located at 63.00, 15.00 in Isle of Quel'Danas, a subzone at the northern most end of Eversong Woods.

Magisters' Terrace is the heart of arcane study for the sin'dorei, including Magister Umbric, long ago. Within its halls lies the Cynosure of Twilight, the key to unlocking the way into the Voidstorm.

8.1.

Bosses

  • Arcanotron Custos: This highly advanced arcane construct has been charged with keeping the peace and ensuring that all Magisters adhere to rules and restrictions. Veering from said rules will not be tolerated.
  • Seranel Sunlash: An accomplished Spellbreaker, Serenel Sunlash has earned the full trust of the Magisters. Charged with the protection of the Cynosure of Twilight, Seranel will fulfill those duties with his very life if necessary.
  • Gemellus: An otherworldly spawn of Void origins, Gemellus seems to utilize the Void not only for its own protection, but to propagate and foster the development of its species as well.
  • Degentrius: A powerful creature of the Void, Degentrius has taken advantage of the opportunity inadvertently provided by Magister Umbric and launched an assault on the Terrace.
Magisters' Terrace Dungeon Guide
9.

Nexus-Point Xenas Dungeon

Nexus-Point Xenas is located at 64.75, 61.75 in Voidstorm.

A fractured facility teetering on the edge of collapse. Once a hub of innovation, its core now pulses with unstable void and arcane energy. Brave adventurers must navigate its shifting wings, confront voidwalking guardians, and uncover the truth behind its unraveling power.

9.1.

Bosses

  • Chief Corewright Kasreth: Chief Corewright Kasreth and the Shadowguard Ethereals once upheld flawless energy flow within the Nexus-Point's Corespark Engine. But Lothraxion's radiant disruption shattered their balance. Now, cloaked in mistrust and weary of outsiders, they labor to restore the arcane harmony that once sustained the Nexus-Point.
  • Corewarden Nysarra: Corewarden Nysarra guards Nexus-Point Xenas with waning strength. Lightscarred by Lothraxion's assault, she broods in her wing, wounded and waiting. The Nullward stirs with battle, and her wrath sharpens for any who dare approach.
  • Lothraxion: Blinded by betrayal, Lothraxion storms the Nexus-Point alone. With its defenses shattered, he prepares to breach the Nexus Core, risking a chain eruption that could annihilate Silvermoon and ripple across Azeroth itself.
Nexus-Point Xenas Dungeon Guide
10.

Voidscar Arena Dungeon

Voidscar Arena is located at 53.70, 34.00 in Slayer's Rise, a subzone of Voidstorm.

The Voidscar Arena awaits worthy challengers! Overseer Charonus has filled the arena with opponents plucked from across Azeroth, forcing them to participate in his games.

10.1.

Bosses

  • Taz'Rah: The domanaar's prized champion, Taz'Rah, is forced to fight against his will. Taz'Rah demands his own death from every opponent, hoping each battle will finally end his suffering.
  • Atroxus: Imprisoned by Charonus, this starving behemoth is hoping for a new victim to sate his appetite. Atroxus's sheer size is almost as dangerous as the poison it spews.
  • Charonus: The overly confident and ostentatious owner of the Voidscar Arena, Charonus, is impressed by the fighting ability of Azerothians and demands them for his grand collection.
11.

Altar of Fangs Dungeon

Altar of Fangs is located at 47.20, 68.50 in Vaults of Atal'Utek, a subzone of The Coiled Isle.

Upon the Altar of Fangs, the ancient Amani sealed the vaults of Atal'Utek with the Fang of Ula'tek. Only the cursed dagger has the power to unseal the prison of the great weapon of the Amani. Aid Orewyna and Liadrin in their pursuit of Zul'jan, who has entered this accursed place in a misbegotten attempt to bring lost glory back to the Amani.

11.1.

Bosses

  • Rav'i: This ravenous hydra has survived this cursed place through scavenging the meat of the fallen. That doesn't mean it is not a fearsome combatant, eager to add some fresh temple explorers to its otherwise rotting diet.
  • The Writhing Coil: In the feeding frenzy upon each other, there has been one Child of Ula'tek that has proved victorious over the rest of the brood. With every battle won, the twisting monstrosity known as the Writhing Coil only grows stronger.
  • Zul'jan: With the Fang of Ula'tek, Zul'jan performs the final ritual to gather power to release the monstrous weapon his ancestors sealed away thousands of years ago. Still held in the sway of the spirit of Malacrass, Zul'jan is unaware that the Fang is also the only hope for his sister Zul'jarra's survival.
12.

Dungeon Rotation for Midnight Season 2

The following dungeons are in rotation in Season 2. The seasonal rotation applies to both Heroic and Mythic Dungeons.

  • Murder Row (Silvermoon City)
  • Den of Nalorakk (Zul'Aman)
  • The Blinding Vale (Harandar)
  • Voidscar Arena (Voidstorm)
  • Altar of Fangs (The Coiled Isle, Vaults of Atal'Utek)
  • Ruby Life Pools (The Waking Shores)
  • King's Rest (Zuldazar)
  • Temple of Sethraliss (Voldun)
13.

Item Level of Gear from Dungeons in Midnight Season 2

Here are the Item Levels of rewards from dungeons in Midnight Season 2:

  • Normal difficulty dungeons drop non-upgradeable Item Level 259 gear.
  • Heroic difficulty dungeons drop Item Level 276 Adventurer 4/6 gear.
  • Baseline Mythic 0 dungeons drop Item Level 292 Champion 1/6 gear. These dungeons are on a weekly lockout.
14.
